context_markdown:
This register records known, intentional differences between the supplied printed source and this working edition. Entries follow score order: movement, then local bar number. The choices below are adopted for the present edition; this does not claim to reconstruct the original transcriber's intentions.

The review covers all four movements and all 24 pages of the supplied scan, with magnified checks of identified passages. It is a source comparison, not a new critical edition or a guarantee that every small mark has been independently verified. The source is the Breitkopf & Härtel collected edition, as reprinted by Dover; it is not an autograph.

Bar numbers restart in each movement. Passage boundaries can fall within a bar. Images show representative locations, and captions identify their extent. Edition excerpts are rendered from the current native MuseScore file.

records.body_markdown:
**Source:** End-repeat at end of Scherzo; no Fine. The end of Trio, m145, says Scherzo D.C.

**Edition:** Fine supplied at the end of the Scherzo.

**Editorial reason:** Clarifies the endpoint of the Scherzo da-capo return indicated at the end of the Trio (m.145).

records.title: ED-012 — Triplet numeral supplied
records.body_markdown:
**Source:** Four unnumbered groups of triplet sixteenths.

**Edition:** Triplet numeral 3 supplied on the first group; subsequent groups remain unnumbered.

**Editorial reason:** Clarifies the 2/4 rhythmic subdivision without altering the notes or durations.

**Edition:** Numeral 3 supplied to each of those two groups.

**Editorial reason:** Makes the implied triplet subdivision explicit.

records.title: ED-016 — Triplet numeral supplied
records.body_markdown:
**Source:** Two unnumbered triplet-sixteenth groups on beat 1.

**Edition:** A visible numeral 3 is supplied on the second triplet group (D-flat5–C5–B4); the first group remains unnumbered.

**Editorial reason:** The explicit numeral clarifies the subdivision. Its retention is a choice of the present edition; the origin of the isolated numeral is undocumented.
